{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient
# This ensures one row per patient, as per data dictionary
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check: now we have 800 rows, one per patient
print(f"Deduplicated shape: {df_dedup.shape}")
print(f"Unique patient_id count: {df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Correct assay_batch B: biomarker_final values are in µg/L, so divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
# Batch A is already in ng/mL, so no change needed
# Apply correction
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Compute the mean across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

print(f"Mean biomarker_final (corrected, ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}")

# Output the mean
mean_biomarker_final"}
